1.

The main grievance in the present Writ Petition and the only one that is pressed before us is that though the Petitioner has made an Application to the Collector to make the Reference to the Authority under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the 2013 Act") the said Application has not been disposed of by the Collector.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
This is despite the fact that the Hon'ble Supreme Court Godrej And Boyce Manufacturing Ltd vs State Of Maharashtra on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80304660/
1 had directed that upon filing of a Reference by the Petitioner for SEPTEMBER 11, 2023 Utkarsh 17.wp(l).19756.2023.doc enhancement of compensation, the Jurisdictional Court shall dispose of the Reference within a period of 6 months.
2.

entities.text: Supreme Court Godrej And Boyce Manufacturing Ltd vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel appearing for the Petitioner therefore submitted that the Collector be directed to decide the Application of the Petitioner seeking a Reference in a time bound manner.

3. The learned AGP appearing on behalf of the State submitted that there is a question of delay in filing the Application that would also have to be considered by the Collector before making a Reference, if any.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, we direct that the Collector shall decide the Application filed by the Petitioner dated 28th February, 2023, (including the question of delay, if any), within a period of 30 days from today.
5. The Writ Petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.

[ B. P. COLABAWALLA, J.] SEPTEMBER 11, 2023 Utkarsh Godrej And Boyce Manufacturing Ltd vs State Of Maharashtra on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80304660/
